title: Morrow billing contract version 1.1
$comment: Billing routes by origin (ADR-0015; P01.T04a). Additions and declared replacements over https://morrow.local/contracts/v1/billing.schema.json, which stays byte-identical. A billing definition resolves here first, then in billing v1 (docs/contracts/contract-versions.md). Replacements of v1 names are listed in changes.json.

BillingRoute.description: A workspace's one billing route (ADR-0015): Morrow sells on Stripe Billing with Stripe Tax, or Shopify App Pricing collects.

PaymentMode.description: Provider mode of a billing record or event. Production accepts only live; development and staging accept only test (R9).

StripePaymentKey.description: A Stripe invoice: stripe:invoice:in_<id>. A PaymentIntent, Checkout Session or Charge id is never a payment key.

ShopifyPeriodKey.description: One App Pricing billing period: shopify:app:<n>:shop:<n>:cycle:<currentBillingCycle.startTime>, numeric GID tails without leading zeros and UTC to the second.

ShopifyPlanChangeKey.description: One App Pricing plan change: shopify:app:<n>:shop:<n>:update:<SUBSCRIPTION_UPDATED occurredAt>.

PaymentKey.description: Canonical key of one verified payment. Morrow grants credits at most once per (route, mode, paymentKey). Every key is a valid core Id.

ShopifySubscriptionKey.description: An App Pricing subscription: shopify:app:<n>:shop:<n>:created:<SUBSCRIPTION_CREATED occurredAt>, recorded at first observation and never re-derived.

SubscriptionKey.description: Canonical key of one provider subscription; valid as a core Id, so it fits v1 subscriptionId fields.

ShopifyPriceKey.description: An App Pricing plan handle read back from the Partner API: shopify:plan:<handle>. A redirect's plan_handle is never a source.

PriceKey.description: Key of a provider price or plan in Morrow's terms table. A published key keeps its credit quantity forever.

OperatorEntitlementKey.description: A staging operator test entitlement (ADR-0022 item 5 amendment, 2026-10-21): morrow:operator_entitlement:<id>. It names the operator grant that fixed a Morrow-direct route in test mode and the entitlement it gives; it is never a payment key, a subscription key of a provider, or a price.

UsdBillingMoney.description: An exact non-negative USD amount (App Pricing prices are USD only).

WorkspaceBillingRoute.description: The server-held billing route of one workspace. Written only by trusted server writers; never a request field. route, mode, routeFixedAt and fixingPaymentKey are all null or all set. Morrow-direct is fixed only for a website workspace that was never Shopify-bound; Shopify only for a Shopify-bound one. A Morrow-direct route fixed by a staging operator test entitlement (ADR-0022 item 5 amendment) names its OperatorEntitlementKey in place of a payment key and is always test mode.

VerifiedPaymentEvent.description: A provider payment Morrow verified server-side and read back (Stripe invoice.paid; an App Pricing cycle from a Partner API read). amountPaid is the money collected; creditUnits come only from BillingTerms. Tenant ids are null together only for an unattributed event. Stripe operationId is the OperationLedger operation the object traces to, or null when it traces to none (held NOT_MORROW_INITIATED). A Shopify event is never a top_up. Shopify-route amounts are USD (App Pricing prices are USD only).

PaymentReversal.description: A verified refund or dispute of a payment (R11), read back before any write. While open, the payer whose payment it reverses is not billable. A reversal of a payment that granted nothing is recorded only. Shopify-route amounts are USD.

BillingTerms.description: Morrow's versioned terms table: the only source of creditUnits (R10). Keyed by the provider price or plan read back from the provider object. A Shopify entry is a USD subscription_period. The schema rejects only an exactly repeated entry; the billing library rejects a table that repeats a (route, mode, priceKey) with different values. Values are fixtures until P18 pricing. A development or staging revision may carry one operator_test_entitlement entry (ADR-0022 item 5 amendment): the beta plan's credits for a staging operator test entitlement, with no provider price (priceKey morrow:operator_plan:beta), test mode only; it is never a purchasable offer.

UsageCap.description: Morrow's cap on post-paid Shopify-route extra credits for one installation's current cycle and meter (R10). Shopify route only; zero by default (top-ups default off).

BillingAccount.description: BillingAccount@2 (replaces billing v1 BillingAccount; changes.json). Morrow-direct: the workspace's one storeless account. Shopify: one account per associated installation, kept across disconnects. A Shopify account is in USD.

EntitlementSnapshot.description: EntitlementSnapshot@2 (replaces billing v1 EntitlementSnapshot; changes.json): a server projection of a fresh provider read. subscriptionId holds the SubscriptionKey; installation and store follow the account's rule. A staging operator test entitlement's snapshot (ADR-0022 item 5 amendment) is Morrow-direct, test mode, with its OperatorEntitlementKey as subscriptionId and the grant record's digest as providerEvidenceRef.

CreditGrant.description: CreditGrant@2 (replaces billing v1 CreditGrant; changes.json). Unique per (route, mode, paymentKey). Shopify-route extra credits are post-paid usage, never a grant, so a Shopify grant is always included.

AllocationShare.description: AllocationShare@2 (replaces billing v1 AllocationShare; changes.json): a storeless share pays from a Morrow-direct account; a store-bound share from that store's Shopify account.

CostAllocation.description: CostAllocation@2 (replaces billing v1 CostAllocation; changes.json): v1 fields over v1.1 shares.

TestEntitlementSeed.description: An owner-run, audited, capped and expiring test entitlement for one workspace and named stores (ADR-0015 follow-up decision OQ-2 (a)). Accepted only in development and staging; production readers refuse it. It fixes no route, creates no account on either route and is never a payment.

RateCardModelRate.description: One catalogue entry's rates: credits per million tokens of each kind (output includes thinking) and its worst-case turn in credits. An entry without a rate is refused at admission.

RateCard.description: RateCard@1 (ADR-0026 item 5; PR 10): the shape of docs/decisions/rate-card.json, versioned, digest-pinned data that publishes only with the owner's recorded confirmation. It meters model tokens per catalogue entry, computer minutes and email sends, converted to whole credits once per run. No version is published by this change.

caps.description: Rate card v1 configuration (ADR-0026 item 4): lowerable by merchants, raised only by the Owner. Basis points of the monthly grant, except the look-for-work cap: a USD amount of worst-case vendor cost per agent per day (ADR-0036 item 7, which replaced its 1% of the grant per pass).

margin.description: Each rate's vendor cost is at most this share of the lowest net revenue per credit after the fee (ADR-0026 item 5: 50% at 17.9%).

free.description: Exactly the free activities; revoke and stops are never paid.
